title: TrailheadSettings - Metadata API
description: Represents an org’s integration with Trailhead for Learning Paths or Enablement programs, including access to enablement sites (formerly myTrailhead).

enableConfettiEffect.description: Indicates whether animated confetti plays on the screen after a user reaches certain milestones, such as completing an Enablement program in the Guidance Center. The default value of this field is false.

enableMyTrailheadPref.description: Indicates whether the org is connected to an enablement site (myTrailhead). The default value of this field is true.

enableTrailheadInLexTerms.description: Indicates whether the terms and conditions for showing Trailhead content in Lightning Experience are accepted in your org. The default value of this field is false.
